Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in the specified document. Join docs by chembl_id to get doc_id, then join compound_records on doc_id to link to molecules, and join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Retrieve canonical SMILES from compound_structures as an INNER JOIN. Sort the results by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
